outcome_sought: Not yet stated by the customer. Her sister wants further payments stopped and the £23,400 recovered.
rationale: Nine authorised Faster Payments to a romance fraudster make this an APP scam for Fraud and Scams on the 8-week clock. The claim was made within thirteen months of the last payment (29 Sep 2026), so under CP-7.2 the whole series is in scope, even though the first two payments are more than thirteen months old. The pack must not drop them. The sister has no authority (CP-1.2), the customer has not given her own outcome or account of events, and her vulnerability means no excess and a warm handover.
